About MVK

Magallu Vetri Kazhagam is a community organization from Magallu. This section is editable and can be updated by the organization at any time.

01

Who We Are

Magallu Vetri Kazhagam (MVK) is a community organization based in Magallu. It was formed with youth awareness, social responsibility and the welfare of the people as its guiding aims, and it is committed to the dignified, all-round development of Magallu village.

02

Our Vision

A Magallu that moves ahead with dignity and comprehensive development, where young people are aware and engaged, and where the welfare of every resident comes first.

03

Our Values

People – the welfare of residents is at the centre of everything we do.
Service – we take social responsibility seriously and stand with the community.
Progress – we work steadily for the all-round development of the village.

04

Our Goals

  • Build awareness among the youth of Magallu.
  • Act on our social responsibility towards the community.
  • Promote the welfare of the people and the development of the village.
05

Our Activities

Programmes, public events and announcements from MVK are shared in the Activities, Gallery and News sections of this website as they are organized and published.

Leadership

Meet the President of Magallu Vetri Kazhagam.

MVK Party President

Shri Gunti Abhimanyu

Shri Gunti Abhimanyu is the President of Magallu Vetri Kazhagam (MVK) and leads the organization from Magallu. MVK works with youth awareness, social responsibility and the welfare of the people as its guiding aims, and its President stands behind the organization's commitment to the dignified development of the village.
